description.narrative: The Justice and Peace Commission of Lubango aims at setting up and maintaining active justice and peace commissions in the 4 vicariates of the Archdiocese. These local commissions will meet at a regular basis and function as spaces of dialogue and activities that characterizes an active citizenry. The staff of the Archdiocesan Justice and Peace Commission will be trained as trainers in participatory techniques such as social monitoring, participation in formal consultative councils (CACS) and 2 other themes to be identified. They will use these skills to support and accompany the vicariate J&Ps in applying the techniques and tools for active citizenry. The Archdiocesan J&P team will carry out three participatory poverty assessments in collaboration with the vicariate J&Ps to bring attention to the socioeconomic conditions of the Archdiocese and use these to inform dialogue with decision makers. Armed with these tools the members of the vicariate J&Ps will seek active participation in their local consultative council and hence strengthen democracy and socio-economic justice in the country.
